notes.title: Sandbox Update + New DLC - Patch Notes for July 10th, 2025
notes.notes:
We have just released a major free update to TRDS for Windows players on Steam. The update adds Sandbox mode, increases the player count from four to five, and takes the first step toward unifying game features across the console, PC and mobile versions. 

Because the work to unify features, including cross-platform play and universal leaderboards, across platforms is complicated, we will be releasing this update one platform at a time. Next up is the macOS version for Steam, followed by Epic Games, then consoles, and eventually mobile. Stay tuned for more news, we expect the additional PC releases to be coming quite soon.



Full patch notes for today's update:

Optimizations for better game performance.

A complete overhaul of the online session system, making the game more stable for online play.

Increased player count to 5 in a single online play session.

A retry option has been added after completing deliveries.

Improved vehicle spawns.

Reduced camera shake while moving quickly and tilting airborne vehicles.

Cross-Platform Multiplayer support.

New cross-platform leaderboards.

Native Invites



We have also released the Atari Attire DLC which adds five multiplayer events, 10 delivery missions and 15 character skins inspired by classic Atari games - plus one surprise skin from Nightdive Studios.

notes.title: Infogrames Announces Major Update, New DLCs and Physical Distribution for TRDS
notes.notes:
Infogrames, a subsidiary of Atari, today announced that Totally Reliable Delivery Service will receive a major free update this summer, unifying game features and content across PC, console and mobile versions of the game. The new update will also increase the player count from four to five, in addition to adding cross-platform play and universal leaderboards. Players will also be treated to two new DLCs that expand the game’s offering with new content, native versions for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and physical distribution for Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5. 

[previewyoutube=3qNGWADDabM;full][/previewyoutube]
The new DLCs – Atari Attire and Mascot Madness – will each add five new multiplayer events, 10 new delivery missions and 15 new character skins. Atari Attire ($2.99 USD), which feature character skins based on Atari games (and one surprise from Nightdive Studios), will launch early this summer with the game update, while Mascot Madness ($2.99 USD) is set to release on September 12. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3708960/Totally_Reliable_Delivery_Service__Atari_Attire/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3708970/Totally_Reliable_Delivery_Service__Mascot_Mayhem/
Pre-orders begin today for the Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5 ($29.99 USD) physical versions, which will include the two new DLCs and all the content from prior DLCs, including Stunt Sets, Cyberfunk and Dress Code. The Totally Reliable Delivery Service physical versions are expected to ship and hit retail shelves on September 12. 

Total Reliable Delivery Service is an all-ages multiplayer sendup of the package delivery world. The game first released in April 2020 and built a strong following for its absurd gadgets, unlikely delivery vehicles and a healthy dose of multiplayer chaos. It was acquired by Infogrames in April, 2024.

“We purchased Totally Reliable Delivery Service with the goal of building upon the game’s early success and expanding distribution,” said Geoffroy Châteauvieux, Manager of Infogrames LLC. “I am thrilled that we have been able to fulfill that goal, and can now bring an improved and expanded experience to both existing fans and new players.”

notes.title: Totally Reliable Delivery Service Is Live On macOS And Dropped A Major Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings, drivers!

🚚 📦Totally Reliable Delivery Service just dropped off another major update!


In the meantime, the game has been Totally Delivered to 💻 Macs! If you are one of the macOS users that have been interested in sending packages while causing some collateral damages, grab the game now with 30% off! 

This new package to be picked up might be a bit heavy as the update contains an exhaustive list of changes including but not limited to in-game settings, a new event and more!! To show you around the new stuff, our devs will hop on a quick ride and start a live stream session at 12 pm PDT, July 28!

Watch it live here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1011670/Totally_Reliable_Delivery_Service/

[hr][/hr]
Without further ado, let’s dive into the hottest updates:

🔍 Totally Reliable TUTORIAL:

https://i.imgur.com/XVVuh7K.gif

Your first day as a delivery driver can get smoother now with the new Tutorial Session. Before you hop on a larger truck and find your journey a little too bumpy, run through the training tasks located in the Warehouse first and hone your skills. Never underestimate the power of a good onboarding experience.

🚀 Rocket Car Rally Event:


https://i.imgur.com/KLLyUPi.gif

Fly the Rocket Car from GASA in the fastest way possible and be the first in your group to reach the Hustle Beach! Following the cart racing event, a new Rocket Car Rally Event is now live in the game. Boost to the beach safe and fast, captain.

🎇Summertime Fireworks:

https://i.imgur.com/fL0WCdI.gif

Get a BANG out of your Totally Reliable ride and celebrate the summer with some splendid fireworks. Interactable objects that can turn into fireworks have been implemented around the map exclusively for this summertime!


🔰 Added Hooks for more secure deliveries in the air:

https://i.imgur.com/B1KS59C.gif

How about having both hands available to focus on a nice sky stunt when flying the biplane or the helicopter? The newly added hooks on the vehicles can save your trouble of having to multitask between being a good captain and worrying about losing the packages. Simply hang your stuff on the attached hooks in flight and leave the concerns behind!

[hr][/hr]

Besides the mentioned updates above, there are a number of other major changes that can improve your delivery experience！


 Updated Main Menu Flow - Now you can choose from Play Local / Play Online / Tutorial 
 Joystick HUD Visualizer - On-screen interface to help visually teach our Totally Reliable joystick interactions (always on in Tutorial and toggle in Settings for switching on in main game) 
 Character Strength Improvement - Strength now builds over time, resulting in the character being twice as strong as before 
 Ping Deliveries - Find the location of deliveries/events in game through pinging it in the Leaderboards pause menu tab 
 And more!


Check the full list that includes more content/game mechanism updates and bug fixes here!

Before wrapping it up, we want to thank you drivers again for playing the game and staying with us while we strive to deliver better content and fix bugs. We hope this big update can add some more good memories to your Totally Reliable journey! As usual, join us at our online communities to mingle with fellow drivers and let us know your thoughts!


 Twitter
 Facebook
 Instagram
 Discord Server


P.S. Drivers, keep your eyes out for a little something called the Freeplay/Sandbox mode as that might be the entrée we serve for the next major update!


Best,
tinyBuild and We’re Five Games

notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're still hard at work on making improvements and fixed to the game! Here is therefore a new update which contains A LOT of cool tweaks and tricks. Check it out below. Also if you have not seen, we are currently running a cosmetic contest with really cool prizes for the winners! Come check it out on our Discord (link at the end).

This update contains the following changes:
 Location-based achievements can now be (re)done if an earlier attempt failed to record properly.
 The vehicle enter assist no longer goes off more than needed for online guest players.
 Revamped the whole character respawn system to reduce frame drops when a player respawns, or a new player arrives in the game.
 Talking to the wizard will now work properly when playing as a guest player on an online server.
 Updated the « Secret code » input field localization and spacing.
 Various character cosmetic fixes.
 Made some changes on the Palm tree collider.

 Fixed an issue with the « Hide UI » toggle in Photo Mode.
 Fixed an issue related to purchasing items in the character shop.
 Fixed an issue with double-click for pings on the in-game map.
 Fixed the join room hanging after joining and leaving a password protected server.
 Fixed clipping on lock crates.
 The host can now interact with wizards even though a client is in the wizard panel already.
 Fixed an issue with initial tutorial tips being hidden when they should not be.

notes.title: Update 2.00.07 - Fix for Missing Deliveries and More
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

We finally managed to single out where the issue with the missing deliveries was coming from! This was a very deeply involved issue which took us several days to find and fix. We hope this will resolve the issue for all of you who have been reporting missing delivery boxes. If by any chance this does not solve your issue it would be awesome if you could get in touch wit us via Discord so that we can investigate further and fix it for you asap.  

But that's not all - here are the additional changes we just released with this last update:
 Added an error log error if there are bad challenges when spawning objects for a delivery
 Increased the serialization rate by ~45% for our network in order to reduce input lag
 If the host of a game has medium quality (orange/yellow) the FPS counter will now make assess the server as medium rather than rounding it up
 Added a control to verify that host/client load playerOptions from index 0 instead of from the index of the order they joined as client. This should fix the situations when a setting appears as checked on while it actually isn't.
 Prevent photo mode from overriding camera culling settings after exiting photo mode
 Photo mode no longer messes with hide hud player options and properly resets when exiting photo mode
 Fixed a local multiplayer UI issue which made the photo mode unusable
 Stunt sets NPC and delivery acceptor positions have been fixed
 Building topper have been removed from Cyberfunk City and moved to Stunt Sets Islands
 The GASA rockwall has been plugged

This is just one of the many patches that are coming in order to act on all the feedback we are receiving from the community. If you want to stay updated on our latest and past fixes then feel free to subscribe to our update thread here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1011670/discussions/0/3069740688723324719/ 

And here is our Discord in case you want to join in with our community to discuss how could we improve the game or if you just want to bring to our attention an issue you have been having: https://discord.com/invite/totallyreliable

notes.title: Totally Reliable Status Update
notes.notes:
Hey delivery drivers,

Since the release of the game last week we have received a lot of feedback from the community and we've been hard at work to quickly fix all reported issues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34331329/6d3fb1ff92156b935eb86c5abad9036761e1a744.gif

We thought, as it has been one week since release, this might be a good time to take a step back and have a look at what we have done so far. This is also a great opportunity, for all of you who brought us feedback, to see how valuable your help has been.

Major fixes:

2nd of April 2021 - 2.00.03
Players will now be able to change graphic settings while in-game. This will be a temporary fix for the lagging issue which partially stemmed from the host struggling to render the game for everyone. 
Free camera mode issues that would send the camera into a spin have been fixed. 
A bug with the terrain on GASA island has been fixed.
3rd of April 2021 - 2.00.04
Input lag decreased by reducing the degree of online visual smoothing (this change will be visible to players on an online server, not hosts, and might affect some players more than others)
Added a depth of field setting to turn it on/off so as to reduce the depth of field.
Character limits set on server names
Prevent ability to created multiple clones of players in the local join screen
Prevent photo mode when in cutscene
Fix scaling issues with map screen and pause screen
Fix the three blimp deliveries not having package acceptor on the blimp
Fix issue with hovercraft derby and garage spawners spawning vehicles locally and not through photon
Put garages on the ground
Fix graphical bug in the character shop with the shoes tab
3rd of April 2021 - 2.00.05
Added a server health indicator. This indicator will display 1 to 4 health bars depending on the quality of the server that are available. The quality of the server is defined by the ping of the host server combined with yours as well as the FPS of the server host. We then use those two metrics to try and identify what will the quality of your experience be on that server, 1 being low and 4 good.
We took additional steps towards reducing input lag by lowering the online visual smoothing parameter
We added a default "Best Region" option from the server region dropdown list. Selecting this option will automatically direct you towards servers located in the region the closest to you/with the lowest ping. Please note that if you are hosting a game you can find the "Best Region" in which you are hosting by going the "Host" options from the in-game.
We removed some rapid key shortcuts that were switching control scheme layouts/unlocking zones without player knowledge.
Fixed several issues reported in regards to controls dropping/Simple controls & other option toggling
4th of April 2021 - 2.00.053
Fixed an issue in which the server list would go back to the top at refresh, making it difficult to reach server at the bottom of the list.
The server health bar as been moved to the left of the server name in order to differentiate it more clearly from the amount of players
5th of April 2021 - 2.00.06
 Using the "Quick Join" in order to join an online game in your region will now select only servers that have a good health status.
 The vehicle entry assistance feature will now be deactivated automatically if you are currently grabbing an object such as a box or another player.
 Fixed an issue which would display an infinite loading screen when joining a server.
 Updated the UI animations on the Hosting menu which was not working as intended for some players.
 Fixed an issue in which repeated quick succession in.game respawns would cause strong server lag.
 Updated the spawn area of the Booster Club Arena cars wich were bein spawned 5ft off the ground.


There are still some issues that we are currently working on and we are really gratefull for the patience you have shown so far in giving us the space to make all those corrections one by one. So what is the plan ahead you might ask? Although some things might still change depending on the feedback we receive (again feel free to add your grain of salt in the comment section) but below are so far some of the major points we are trying to tackle.

Upcoming Changes:
Input Lag
Although we have made several patches to reduce the general feeling of "lag" (see above) we still see some delay in controls when you play online on someone else's server. This is due to the fact that the game is using a framework in which the person hosting the game needs to receive info from players, process it and send it back to players before they move (in short). The reason we have implemented it this way and not like other multiplayer (&ragdoll) games out there is because our game is much more fast-paced and interactive. In short in this game the data needs to go back and forth before we show on your screen what is happening. For instance we need players to be able to each hold the same box (or eachother) while driving a helicopter at high speed right into the mouth of a Volcano (true story). For this to work the host needs to be able to calculate at each second what each player is doing so that they are all correctly syncronized. Furthermore the fact that the host should have a fairly low ping for the game to run smoothly, as well as a reasonably good computer to process the information for the 1-3 other players on the server, adds a layer of complexity to our system. That being said we have a few leads to improve the situation without making this game into another one and you should start to see it coming during the next few weeks.

No place to deliver
We have received reports from some players  who are not able to find the delivery location for their parcels. We are currently focusing hard on fixing this and believe we should have an update ready in a few days. That being said as far as we know this update might cause the loss of progression for those players who are having this issue. A necessary evil to solve the problem but we are still very sorry that it might come down to this and are currently working on finding a way to avoid it. In the meantime if you are one of the players experiencing this issue the quick-fix we have for this is to delete your save file which is located in your game folder, under the name "progress.dad". We know this is not ideal and fairly frustrating for those experiencing this issue so rest assured a fix will come very soon. 

We also want to send a quick shout out to anyone who might be having this issue: it would be awesome if you could come chat with us on Discord, by reporting your issue in the Bug section, so that we can work with you to resolve it. Link to the Discord at the bottom of this post.

Tutorial
The tutorial currently implemented in the game allows you to quickly grasp the controls of the game before starting your journey as a delivery driver. We would like to improve this a little by also granting you the opportunity to learn about the different devices and mechanics available in the game with a more focused guidance. We will be working on this in the coming weeks!

Control scheme
We currently have 2 control schemes implemented in the game. By default you will have the new "Simplified controls" which allow you to use one button/key to grab with both hands and one to raise both hands. But if you want you can go in the settings and revert to the old control scheme which had you manage each arm independently (both for grabbing and raising, so 4 buttons instead of 2 with simplified controls). We have received feedback that the new simplified controls were still not exactly what some of you would have wanted and so we are looking into how could we improve this further.

Bugs
We still have some bugs that are being worked on and we will continue to get those sorted out one by one in the comings days/weeks,

In Conclusion:
Thank you again for all you support, we are hard at work on making the game better and will continue to bring you updates and new content as long as there is a community who wants them. 

Feel free to discuss in the chat below if you have any comments on what was presented above or if you would like us to bring to the game in the next few month.

Also if you have any issues or just want to come chat with us and our community please feel free to join us on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/totallyreliable
